resourceBoundary.policy: Complete correlated retained placement receipt or typed refusal; no raw document, resource or path payload.

semantics: Placement edits use the existing native project asset catalog/history/request receipts. Changed place/setOffset/shiftOffset/remove/enableTimeRemap/removeTimeRemapKey/disableTimeRemap/setTimeRemapKey/setInterpMode publishes one revision and undo entry; T12 video timing (bounded remap intents: enableTimeRemap writes the baseline two linear keys and refuses an existing remap, removeTimeRemapKey deletes the keys at one frame, disableTimeRemap clears the track, setTimeRemapKey sets one key through the shared property key kernel; interpMode written with frameBlend = interpMode !== 'none') is admitted only on a video drawing placement, travels through every offset edit and persists in the saved project; semantic no-op preserves stored number spelling, bytes and redo. Exact retry returns its retained receipt before stale checking, including after undo. Drawing/Video offsets keep original integer admission; AudioTrack offsets preserve finite fractional values within the same safe bound. Audio targets require the stored AudioID record and its exact validated embedded WAV source; no missing-owner, linked-source or MIME-only fallback. Supported WAV admission is PCM8/16/24/32 or IEEEfloat32 mono/stereo with strict RIFF structure; other original codecs and actual native playback/export remain unavailable. Audio metadata, authored Motion/static volume and source bytes persist in the same native document authority. Ordinary UI and installed full AudioTrack acceptance remain pending.

examples.label: Video offset edit through shared owner; AudioTrack and installed acceptance remain pending
